items.name: Tyrant's Forgehands
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create a BRAND-NEW transparent fantasy RPG inventory sprite depicting a PAIR of legendary wearable gauntlets. Ashmaw: two blackened dragonsteel gauntlets with broad overlapping crimson scale plates, sculpted bronze cuffs resembling a dragon's brow, one glowing ruby ember on each backhand, molten seams, only a few translucent orange fire wisps. Fierce but compact, rich painterly metal and scale texture. Hand-painted semi-realistic fantasy item art with crisp dark outlines, dimensional shading and brilliant edge highlights, matching ornate raid-unique equipment in the game. Composition: two separate gauntlets in matching three-quarter view, cuffs toward upper-left/upper-right, armored backs toward viewer, fingers pointing diagonally down and slightly inward. The gauntlets should look wearable over NORMAL HUMAN HANDS, informed by the anatomy of the input reference images. On EACH hand show exactly FIVE digits: FOUR separate fingers across a gently arched knuckle line plus ONE distinct side thumb attached LOWER than the fingers. Proportions: middle longest, index and ring a little shorter, pinky clearly shorter; each finger bends naturally at two joints and tapers toward a blunt armored tip. A thumb emerges from the side of the palm near the wrist, angled across; narrow wrist beneath decorated cuff. Show all TEN fingertips visibly separated; four finger tips and one thumb tip per hand. Keep both hands in frame with clear margins. Legendary grandeur from silhouette, focal gem, skilled metalwork and restrained translucent effects; leave hand anatomy clear. True transparent background, no text, labels, border, people, skin or extra hands. Input image 1: approved paired gauntlet pose/composition reference ONLY; reinvent armor completely. Input image 2: anatomy reference for four fingers and thumb. Input image 3: anatomy reference for flexible armored hand joints.
